definition: a thin leaf of polished metal used in decorating.
example_en: They had stitched a shiny metal leaf onto the border of the sari.

definition: a gift or contribution, as to a charitable organisation.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳೂ ಅವನು ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ವಂತಿಗೆ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: Every month he gives a contribution to the temple.

definition: an interjection used to express doubt, wonder, appreciation, etc.
example_en: Oh! What a beautiful sight this is.

definition: to suffer pain; to undergo affliction; to be persecuted.
example_en: He suffered affliction for a long time due to illness.

definition: an idol, statue, etc. carved in a stone.
example_en: A beautiful stone idol has been placed in the temple.

definition: organised armed land force; an army.
example: ರಾಜನ ಮೋಹರ ಗಡಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಶಿಬಿರ ಹೂಡಿತು.
example_en: The king's army camped near the border.

definition: an uncultured, uncivilised man.
example_en: That uncultured man did not listen to anyone.

definition: act of refusing; refusal; rejection.
example_en: He was upset when his request was met with refusal.

definition: the woody vine Bougainvillea spectabilis of Nyctaginaceae family, having inconspicuous flowers surrounded by large, showy purple or red bracts; bougainvillaea.
example_en: The bougainvillaea flowers bloomed on the wall.

definition: the act of knowing.
example_en: The knowing of truth changes a person.

definition: the rain water got by a river (that looks mud-coloured) during monsoon.
example_en: The muddy monsoon water was flowing reddish.

definition: a woman or girl as she is related to the another child or other children of her parents; a sister.
example_en: My sister goes to school every day.

definition: to start; to commence; to begin.
example_en: They started the new project.

definition: great lustre.
example_en: The great lustre of the sun reflected in the lake.

definition: to decree; give orders for; to ordain; to order.
example_en: The king ordered the soldiers to set out for battle.

definition: dimness; lack of sufficient light.
example_en: A dim darkness had spread in the room.

definition: any alcoholic drink; liquor.
example_en: Alcoholic liquor is sold in that shop.

definition: the quality of being hot; hotness; heat.
example_en: The heat of the midday sun was extreme.

definition: a short sentence or condensed speech.
example_en: His short, condensed speech won everyone's heart.

definition: the act of refuting or proving another's sense false or wrong; disproof; refutation.
example_en: After the scholar's refutation, the debate came to an end.

definition: of or having the properties of, medicine; curing, healing or relieving.
example_en: The leaves of this plant have healing properties.

definition: to pull up by the roots.
example_en: The gardener pulled the tree up by the roots.

definition: (shape, form) to be lost or distorted.
example_en: The shape of the old statue gradually got distorted.

definition: to be cut; to be incised.
example_en: The cloth was cut by the scissors.

definition: the vine Coccinia cordifolia (= C. indica, = Bryonia grandis, = Momordica monadelpha) of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The tundike vine had spread in the garden.

definition: a single-reed, clarinet-like wind instrument with a wooden or metal tube, played by means of holes.
example_en: The procession moved forward while playing the clarinet-like wind instrument.

definition: a mixed breed or caste.
example_en: That cow belonged to a mixed breed.

definition: a banner or flag containing a symbol representing the kingship or the pontifical insignia.
example_en: They carried the royal banner in the procession.

definition: the plant Artabotrys hexapetalus (= A. odoratissimus) of Annonaceae family;
example_en: A ylang-ylang plant has grown in the corner of the courtyard.

definition: requested, besought for.
example_en: The disciple brought the thing that had been requested by the teacher.

definition: (a dog, wolf, etc.) to utter the characteristic long, loud, wailing cry; to howl.
example_en: The dog howled outside the house.

definition: air; wind.
example_en: In winter the wind felt piercing.

definition: the ability to see clearly; a keen vision.
example_en: He has the keen vision to recognize the truth.

definition: a person who causes mischief; a mischief-maker.
example_en: That mischief-maker stirred up trouble in the town.

definition: a vying for doing something.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಬಹುಮಾನ ಪಡೆಯುವ ಹಮಹಮಿಕೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a vying between the two to win the prize.

definition: a pillar erected as a monument of victory.
example: ರಾಜ ಆ ಯುದ್ಧದ ಜಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮೇಳಿಯನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The king set up a victory pillar for that war's triumph.

definition: the fact or an instance of drinking alcoholic liquor esp. too much.
example_en: Excessive drinking was common in the village on the festival day.

definition: prominent; important.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಐನಾತಿ ವಿಷಯ ಚರ್ಚೆಗೆ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: That important matter came up for discussion in the meeting.

definition: the act of explaining the quality, meaning, nature, context, etc. as to make (something) intelligible; explanation; interpretation.
example: ಕಠಿಣ ಪದಗಳಿಗೆ ಗುರುಗಳು ಸರಳ ಪರಿಭಾಷೆ ನೀಡಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher gave a simple explanation for the difficult words.

definition: (obs.) a type of tax.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಲೋಣಿ ಎಂಬ ತೆರಿಗೆಯ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖವಿದೆ.
example_en: There is a mention of a tax called kālōṇi in the old records.

definition: a hole or passage for (waste) water to go out.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಹಿಂಭಾಗದ ಸೋರುಗಂಡಿಯಿಂದ ತ್ಯಾಜ್ಯ ನೀರು ಹೊರಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Waste water flows out through the drain hole at the back of the house.

definition: to form a line; to follow a queue.
example_en: The students formed a queue and got tickets.

definition: the state or fact of being an owner; ownership.
example_en: The ownership of this building is clearly recorded.

definition: to stand against another in opposition; to defy.
example_en: The enemy army defied our army by standing against it.

definition: the fifth day of the week; Thursday.
example_en: There was a holiday for school on Thursday.

definition: a kind of sugar.
example_en: A kind of sugar called balemuri was being sold in the shop.

definition: to cause to beat; to get (another) smashed (by).
example_en: He got his enemy beaten up on the street.

definition: to cause to join with or together.
example_en: He joined the two pillars together.

definition: a person descended or regarded as descended, from the ancient Hebrews of Biblical times; a jew.
example_en: Many Jews used to live in that town.

definition: the chest - a) that part of the mammalian body between the neck and the abdomen in whose cavity the heart and lungs lie; b) the middle of the three chief divisions of the body of an insect or the corresponding part of a crustacean or an arachnid; c) the fore or ventral part of the body between the neck and the abdomen in humans.
example_en: He was suffering from pain in the chest.

definition: the tree Mechelia champaca of Magnoliaceae family.
example_en: A Michelia champaca tree stands in front of the temple.

definition: a single finger.
example_en: A single finger had swollen up because of the wound.

definition: a word; speech.
example_en: His speech won everyone's hearts.

definition: the evergreen tree Casuarina equisetifolia ( = C. muricata) of Casuarinaceae family, with jointed, green branchlets that bear whorls of scalelike leaves, whose fibrous, strong stems are used as centering material in building construction.
example_en: Casuarina trees have been planted all along the seashore.

definition: the act or an instance of leaping.
example: ಮಗು ಹಾಸಿಗೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಗುದುಕು ಮಾಡಿ ನಗುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: The child is leaping on the bed and laughing.

definition: curdled milk; curds.
example: ಮಜ್ಜಿಗೆಗೆ ಬದಲು ಗೆಡ್ಡೆಮೊಸರು ಬಳಸಿದರೆ ರುಚಿ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If you use curds instead of buttermilk, the taste will be better.

definition: an incompetent, inefficient, feebly ineffectual man; a useless fellow.
example: ಆ ಬಱಡ ಸೋಮಾರಿ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That inefficient, lazy fellow never helped anyone.

definition: to believe or trust completely.
example: ಅವಳು ತನ್ನ ಗೆಳತಿಯನ್ನು ನೆರೆನಂಬು ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದಳು.
example_en: She said to trust her friend completely.

definition: (masc.) one who is born to affluence.
example: ಆ ಆಗರ್ಭಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ತನ್ನ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನು ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಹಂಚಿದನು.
example_en: That man born to wealth distributed his riches to the poor.

definition: a vehicle, usu. having two wheels, drawn by animals, used for carrying goods.
example_en: The farmer carried the grain to the market in a cart.

definition: a device for producing a strong current of air, consisting of a chamber that can be expanded to draw in air through an opening and pressed to expel it through a tube; bellows.
example_en: The blacksmith kindled the fire using the bellows.

definition: to call; to invite; to summon.
example_en: The president invited everyone to the meeting.

definition: (a secret) to be divulged, made known to others; to disclose; to reveal.
example: ಎಷ್ಟು ಬಚ್ಚಿಟ್ಟರೂ ಆ ವಿಷಯ ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಗುಟ್ಟಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: However much it was hidden, that matter was eventually divulged.

definition: to make jingling sound or sounds.
example_en: The dancer's anklets jingled in time with the rhythm.

definition: the organ of sight or vision; the eye.
example_en: Her eyes were dark and beautiful.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The guccha kanda plant is used for medicine.

definition: love; affection; fondness.
example: ಅವಳ ಮನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಮೇಲೆ ಮರ್ಚು ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: Affection for him grew in her heart.

definition: a compact, usu. impure, massive variety of talc, used to make electrical insulators and also to carve idols; soapstone; steatite.
example_en: The idol of that temple was made of soapstone.

definition: (dial.) the money got the previous day.
example_en: Only the previous day's money remained in his pocket.

definition: (pl.) the forest and hilly regions.
example_en: The hunters wandered the forest and hills chasing the deer.

definition: broad; wide.
example_en: That ground is very broad.

definition: the hollow under the arm at the shoulder; the armpit; axilla.
example: ಶಾಸನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೌಂಕುೞ್ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಆರ್ಮ್‌ಪಿಟ್ ಎಂಬ ಅರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: In the inscription, the word 'kauṅkuḷ' is used to mean armpit.

definition: a container made of interwoven cane, strips of wood, thin bamboo slits, etc.; a basket.
example_en: The farmer brought vegetables in a basket.

definition: removed; taken off.
example_en: The stain was removed from that cloth.

definition: a kind of weapon.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಂಡು ಎಂಬ ಆಯುಧವನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In olden times they used a weapon called chandu.

definition: any of various large grasshoppers, esp. a migratory the grasshoppers that often travel in great swarms and destroy nearly all vegetation in areas visited; locust.
example_en: The locusts flew in as if to cover the sky.

definition: having no fragrance; .
example: ಈ ಹೂವು ಅಗಿಲಿಲಿ, ಆದರೆ ನೋಡಲು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This flower has no fragrance, but it is beautiful to look at.

definition: (the wind or a current of air) to move with some force; to blow.
example_en: The wind blew strongly all through the night.

definition: a totally stupid fellow.
example_en: That totally stupid fellow made a mistake again.

definition: the Eternal and Fundamental Principle of the universe.
example_en: The sages contemplated on the fundamental principle of the universe.

definition: a sudden, convulsive, involuntary muscular contraction; spasm.
example_en: Due to fever, the child's hand had a spasm.

definition: an incessant shooting of arrows.
example_en: There was an incessant shower of arrows in the battle.

definition: a tool with a crescent-shaped blade or pointed hook for removing the weeds from a garden, lawn, etc.
example_en: The gardener removed the weeds with the hook-tool.

definition: a sequence of photographs or drawings, having a theme, story, etc., projected on a screen in such rapid succession that they create the optical illusion (because of the persistence of vision) of moving persons and objects; a film; a cinema.
example_en: A new film was released this evening.

definition: indulging oneself excessively in sexual pleasures.
example_en: A life given to excessive sexual pleasure ruined his health.

definition: a man who spends extravagantly.
example: ಆ ಬಿಯಕಾಱ ದುಡ್ಡನ್ನು ಮನಬಂದಂತೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That extravagant man spends money as he pleases.

definition: the impression of the mind; an opinion; a sentiment; a feeling.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನನ್ನ ಎನಿಸಿಕೆ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: My impression about that incident was different.

definition: to be delighted; to be satisfied.
example_en: Having received the gift, she was delighted.

definition: the act of joining, uniting or being joined, united; union.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಗೆಳೆಯರ ಸಮಾಗಮ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: The union of the two friends happened after many years.

definition: the act of biting or stinging.
example_en: His leg was wounded by the dog's bite.

definition: to be injured or collapse by punch or punches with another's fist.
example_en: On the street he was punched and could not get up.

definition: invaluable; inestimable.
example_en: That diamond necklace is invaluable.

definition: a long stride or step, in walking.
example_en: The soldiers marched forward with long strides.

definition: the state of being emotionally disturbed, upset and hence, anxious.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾವೋದ್ವಿಗ್ನತೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that news, emotional disturbance arose in her.

definition: having courage; possessing courageous endurance; brave; fearless; courageous.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳ ದಿಟ್ಟ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾದನು.
example_en: That soldier became known as very brave in the war.

definition: to be corrected (as by removing the faults); to be amended; to be revised and improved.
example_en: The new law needs to be revised and improved.

definition: to look at; to gaze at.
example_en: She was gazing at the distant hill.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: Village people grow the sōḍage plant.

definition: to become filled with valour.
example_en: Hearing the news of the battle, the soldiers became filled with valour.

definition: the chief of a cavalry unit having around one hundred horsemen.
example_en: The cavalry chief led his mounted troops.

definition: a hand weapon having a long, sharp-pointed blade, with a sharp edge on one or both sides, set in a hilt; a broadsword.
example_en: The warrior raised his broadsword and faced the enemy.

definition: to answer or respond in speech; to reply.
example_en: He humbly replied to the teacher's words.

definition: a man who washes clothes, linens, etc., for hire; laundryman.
example_en: The village laundryman cleaned everyone's clothes.

definition: a burden either bundled or packed in a big bag.
example_en: He carried the bundle of clothes on his back.

definition: a foot not wearing footwear; a bare-foot.
example_en: The children ran on the mud bare-foot.

definition: to engage in; or to continue with what one is engaged in; to carry on.
example_en: He carried on his work with dedication.

definition: the first part of the night; evening.
example_en: In the early part of the night, the lamps shone in the village.

definition: to become straight.
example: ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಕಿದ ಬಳ್ಳಿ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಸೆಡೆವಿಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The vine placed in hot water slowly became straight.

definition: any man or boy lacking normal function of the testes, as through castration or disease; an impotent man.
example_en: That impotent man cannot have children.

definition: a pot-bellied man.
example_en: It was hard for the pot-bellied man to bend down and work.

definition: covered; concealed; hidden.
example_en: Her face was covered and concealed by the veil.

definition: a thick rope, cable made of intertwisted strands of fibre, thin wires, etc.
example_en: He tied the oxen with a thick rope.

definition: two umbrellas; a pair of umbrellas.
example_en: They had decorated and kept a pair of umbrellas in the wedding house.

definition: an evil doer; a sinner; a rogue.
example_en: That rogue stole the people's money.

definition: flowered; blooming with flowers.
example_en: The garden was full of blooming plants.

definition: a village or town.
example: ಆ ಬಾಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ಐನೂರು ಜನರು ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: About five hundred people live in that village.

definition: the plant Crotalaria rubiginosa of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The Crotalaria rubiginosa plant has grown in the forest.

definition: the act of seeing, looking at.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಣೆಯ ನಂತರ ರೋಗಿಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಸುಧಾರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After the doctor's observation, the patient's condition improved.

definition: transgression; violation.
example_en: His act was a violation of the rule.

definition: the depression in the center of the surface of the abdomen indicating the point of attachment of the umbilical cord to the embryo; the navel.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೊಕ್ಕುೞು ಎಂಬ ರೂಪ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The old form 'pokkuḷu' meaning navel is found in the ancient poetry.

definition: a chronic disorder or respiration characterised by severe coughing and wheezing and difficulty in breathing; severe asthma.
example_en: Severe asthma made his breathing difficult.

definition: the act of joining different wooden pieces (as in carpentry).
example_en: The carpenter was very skilled in the joining of wooden pieces.

definition: a complaint, accusation or indictment characterised by ignominy.
example_en: His shameful accusation spread throughout the town.

definition: to make a mark on.
example_en: The clerk made a mark on the page of the book.

definition: (astrol.) the ninth sign of the zodiac entered by the sun about November 21; Sagittarius.
example_en: The sun enters Sagittarius on November twenty-first.

definition: a kind of insect.
example: ಎಲೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಟೊಪ್ಪು ಎಂಬ ಕೀಟ ಅಡಗಿಕೊಂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: An insect called toppu had hidden itself among the leaves.

definition: a wild bison (Bibos gaurus).
example_en: The hunters observed the wild bison from a distance.

definition: an increase; a growth; opulence.
example: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತನ ಗೊಬ್ಬು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That rich man's wealth grew day by day through trade.

definition: a kind of soup, from which all solid particles are strained.
example: ಬೇಯಿಸಿದ ದಾಲ್ ಸೋಸಿ ಅವಳು ಕಿಱುಗಟ್ಟು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She strained the cooked lentils and prepared a clear strained soup.

definition: to draw up water from a well (with the help of a rope and a metal pitcher or bucket).
example_en: She drew up water from the well.

definition: the crane Leptoptilus dubius; adjutant crane.
example: ಆ ಹೆಂಗುರು ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗೂಡು ಕಟ್ಟಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That adjutant crane had built a nest on the tree.

definition: the celestial Gangā river.
example_en: By Bhagiratha's penance, the celestial Gangā descended to earth.

definition: the status, office, duty etc. of a minister.
example: ಅವರಿಗೆ ಸಚಿವತೆ ದೊರೆತ ಮೇಲೆ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After he attained ministership, his responsibility increased.

definition: the quality or state of being true; truth.
example_en: The judge examined the truthfulness of the witness.

definition: neatly braided hair.
example_en: Everyone admired her neatly braided hair.

definition: the pronoun (corresponding to he, she, it in English) used in reflexive or reciprocal sense in possessive case.
example_en: He left his (own) book at home.

definition: a woolen blanket.
example_en: The hill people wrap themselves in woollen blankets.

definition: the chief of a region in the erstwhile Maratha state.
example_en: The chief of the region was looking after the taxes of his district.

definition: to be bound with chain, fetters or shackle.
example_en: They bound the thief with chains and took him to prison.

definition: a valorous, brave man; a hero.
example_en: The brave hero defeated the enemies in the war.

definition: one who is not an officer, in a government department or business organisation.
example_en: That man was not an officer in the office.

definition: a highly venerable man; he who is venerated by most venerable person.
example_en: People called the guru a most venerable man.

definition: a repaying off of one's debt fully.
example: ಸಾಲದ ಚುಕತಾ ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After the full repayment of the debt, he felt relieved.

definition: (in comp.) strong or stronger; robust.
example_en: Of the two, he is the stronger one.

definition: a wedge-shaped hand tool of steel with a sharp edge, for cutting or making holes in, metal objects; a chisel.
example_en: The blacksmith bored a hole in the metal with a chisel.

definition: the sound of bellowing (as of a bull, bison, pig, etc.).
example_en: Hearing the bellowing, the farmer got up and came.

definition: a wall surrounding a building.
example_en: The fort's surrounding wall was built very sturdily.

definition: the red colour.
example_en: The red colour of that flower was pleasing to the eye.

definition: a man who provokes strong passion for fighting.
example_en: He, a provoker of fighting spirit, stirred up quarrels in the village.

definition: the act of expanding, enlarging or being expanded, enlarged; dilation; expansion.
example_en: Expansion of the metal occurs due to heat.

definition: a chronic filarial disease resulting in lymphatic obstruction, characterised by marked enlargement of the legs, transmitted by mosquitoes elephantiasis.
example: ಹುತ್ತುಗಾಲು ರೋಗದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಕಾಲುಗಳು ಬಹಳ ಊದಿವೆ.
example_en: Because of the disease elephantiasis, his legs have swollen greatly.

definition: a camel.
example_en: The camel was walking slowly in the desert.

definition: a kind of percussion instrument that has a thick skin membrane.
example_en: At the festival they played the dunduchi and delighted the people.

definition: of or having to do with the inside; happened, happening or caused to happen within; inner; internal.
example: ದೇಶದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆಗೆ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗಮನ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The government paid attention to the country's internal security.

definition: talking or having the tendency to talk, irrelevantly.
example_en: He has an irrelevant-talking nature, speaking all sorts of nonsense.

definition: a part of the body of a plant that develops, typically, from the radicle and grows downward into the soil, anchoring the plant and drawing water and nourishment from the soil and stores food; a root.
example_en: The tree's root had spread underground.

definition: to lay (something) upside down or facing downward; to overturn.
example_en: She turned the pan upside down and placed it on the stove.

definition: to reduce to powder or small pieces; to powder; to pulverise.
example_en: She pulverised the chilli for cooking.

definition: one's own comfort, pleasure, enjoyment, etc.
example_en: He led a solitary life for his own comfort and pleasure.

definition: an institution for receiving, lending, exchanging, and safeguarding money; a bank.
example_en: I have kept the money in the bank.

definition: to form into curd; coagulate.
example: ಬಿಸಿ ಹಾಲಿಗೆ ಹುಳಿ ಸೇರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅದು ಹೆರೆಗಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: When sour was added to the hot milk, it formed into curd.

definition: a firm, fine-grained earth, plastic when wet, composed chiefly of hydrous aluminum silicate minerals, used in the manufacture of bricks, pottery, and other ceramics.
example_en: The potter made the pot from clay.

definition: to flow in stream.
example_en: Water flowed down from the hill in a stream.

definition: a utensil with a rough surface on which to grate coconut, vegetables, etc.; a grater.
example_en: Vegetables must be grated on the grater.

definition: a toothed device of plastic, hard rubber, bone, wood or metal, used for untangling and arranging the hair; a comb.
example_en: The comb that was on the table got lost.

definition: to bite (as to eat something).
example: ಮಗು ಆಟಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಬಾಯಿ ಹಾಕಿ ಜಗಿಯಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The baby put the toy in its mouth and tried to bite it.

definition: a man who pretends to be what he is not; a hypocrite.
example: ಜನರು ಆ ವೇಷಧಾರಿಯ ನಿಜ ಬಣ್ಣ ಕಂಡುಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: People found out the true colours of that hypocrite.

definition: mingled with; associated with; joined with.
example_en: Those matters are associated with one another.

definition: pitch-darkness.
example_en: Pitch-darkness had spread over the forest.

definition: the act of extracting, pulling out, etc.
example_en: Extracting that root is a difficult task.

definition: amounting to sixty.
example_en: Grandmother is now sixty years old.

definition: (masc.) an intimate companion; a friend; a confidant.
example_en: He is my childhood friend.

definition: the condition or fact of something (as hair on the head) being deranged, uncombed.
example_en: Her hair had become deranged and uncombed.
